bestFor: Explore Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath with a well-organized planned Chardham Yatra package from Safar Trails. Enjoy a well structured itinerary, suitable travel arrangements, accommodation and proper dedicated assistance throughout your pilgrimage journey.
overview:
Chardham Yatra is one of the most important pilgrimage journeys in Uttarakhand, covering four destinations - Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath. The journey takes travellers through the beautiful Himalayan scenery while exploring some of the region's most significant pilgrimage sites.

At Safar Trails, we plan your Chardham journey in an easy and well-organized way with thoughtfully planned transport, accommodation, and itineraries. Whether you're travelling with family, friends, or a private group, we offer flexible packages that can be customized to suit your travel dates, duration, and specific requirements.

Our Chardham Yatra packages can be customized according to travellers' needs like starting point, vehicle type, accommodation category and group size.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Haridwar
itinerary.description: Begin your sacred Chardham Yatra with a comfortable journey from Delhi to Haridwar. Check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Har Ki Pauri and witness the Ganga Aarti (subject to timing). Overnight: Haridwar. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Ganga Kinare / Hotel Alpana or similar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.description: Depart for Barkot, the base for the Yamunotri pilgrimage, through scenic mountain roads and lush valleys. Overnight: Barkot. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Hill Prince / Hotel Apaar or similar.

itinerary.title: Barkot - Yamunotri - Barkot
itinerary.description: Drive to Janki Chatti, then continue to Yamunotri by trek/pony/palki (at own cost). Visit the Yamunotri Temple, then return to Barkot. Overnight: Barkot. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Hill Prince / Hotel Apaar or similar.

itinerary.title: Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Proceed towards Uttarkashi through beautiful Himalayan scenery. Evening free for rest. Overnight: Uttarkashi. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Shivlinga / Hotel Hari Ganga or similar.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi - Gangotri - Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Visit the sacred Gangotri Temple and the holy Bhagirathi River, then return to Uttarkashi. Overnight: Uttarkashi. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Shivlinga / Hotel Hari Ganga or similar.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi - Guptkashi / Sitapur
itinerary.description: Continue through mountain valleys and rivers towards Guptkashi/Sitapur, preparing for the Kedarnath Yatra. Overnight: Guptkashi / Sitapur. Suggested Hotel: Kedar Valley Resort / Hotel Raj Palace or similar.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi / Sitapur - Kedarnath
itinerary.description: Proceed to Kedarnath by trek, helicopter or other permitted options (additional cost). Visit the Kedarnath Temple. Overnight: Kedarnath. Suggested Stay: GMVN / Basic Guest House or similar.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath - Guptkashi / Sitapur
itinerary.description: Return journey towards Guptkashi/Sitapur after completing Kedarnath darshan. Overnight: Guptkashi / Sitapur. Suggested Hotel: Kedar Valley Resort / Hotel Raj Palace or similar.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi / Sitapur - Badrinath
itinerary.description: Proceed to Badrinath through the Garhwal Himalayas. Badrinath Temple darshan (subject to timings). Overnight: Badrinath. Suggested Hotel: Hotel Narayan Palace / Hotel Snow Crest or similar.

itinerary.title: Badrinath - Haridwar
itinerary.description: Check out and return journey from Badrinath to Haridwar. Package concludes. Drop: Haridwar.
